items.title: Grok Observatory
items.body: Watch an AI coding assistant's edits replay live, file by file. It replays every save in a local browser tab and works with any agent that edits files in a git repo.

items.title: eeliyarasta.com
items.body: This site. A tiny static-site builder on Vite and GSAP: content in JSON, templates in plain JavaScript, every animation driven by one config file so it can be curated visually.
